description: Admin Dashboard - Local admin interface for viewing users, contacts, and screenshots

userStories.title: Project scaffolding
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a new Next.js project set up so I have a foundation to build the admin dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Create admin-dashboard/ folder parallel to neuron-ai/ and zuzu-app/
Initialize Next.js 14+ with TypeScript and App Router
Add Tailwind CSS for styling
Add basic layout with header showing 'Admin Dashboard'
Create .env.example with placeholders for MONGODB_URI and AWS credentials
Add to .gitignore: .env.local, node_modules/
npm run dev starts successfully on port 3001
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created Next.js 16.1.1 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, App Router. Port 3001 configured.

userStories.title: MongoDB connection service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to connect to local MongoDB so I can query user data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/mongodb.ts with connection pooling
Read MONGODB_URI from environment (default: mongodb://localhost:27017/icebreaker)
Export typed collection accessors for users, contacts, screenshots
Handle connection errors gracefully with console logging
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created lib/mongodb.ts with typed User, Contact, Screenshot interfaces and collection accessors

userStories.title: AWS S3 service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to interact with S3 so I can fetch images and generate signed URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/s3.ts with AWS SDK v3
Function to generate signed URL with configurable expiration (default 1 hour)
Function to check if object exists
Load AWS credentials from environment variables
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created lib/s3.ts with getSignedUrlForObject, objectExists, getObjectMetadata functions

userStories.title: API routes for data fetching
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API routes so the frontend can fetch data server-side.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/users - returns user list with name, email, lastActive, contactCount
GET /api/users/[userId] - returns user with contact summaries
GET /api/users/[userId]/contacts/[contactId] - returns contact with screenshots
GET /api/screenshots/[screenshotId]/signed-url - returns signed S3 URL
All routes return consistent JSON format: { success, data, error? }
Error handling for invalid IDs and DB errors
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created 4 API routes with consistent JSON format and error handling

userStories.title: Users list page
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to see a list of all users so I can browse the user base.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /users page as the home/index page (redirect from /)
Display table with columns: Name, Email, Last Active, Contact Count
Sort by last active time (most recent first)
Show Last Active as relative time (e.g., '2 hours ago', '3 days ago')
Each row is clickable, navigates to user detail page
Show total user count at top
Handle empty state: 'No users found'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Created /users page with table, redirect from home, relative time display, empty state

userStories.title: User detail page
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to view a specific user's contacts so I can investigate their data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /users/[userId] dynamic route
Show user header: name, email, created date, last active
Display contacts as cards in a grid layout
Each contact card shows: name, screenshot count, last updated
Contact cards are clickable, navigate to contact detail
Back button to return to users list
Handle user not found: show 404 message
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Created user detail page with header, contact cards grid, back button, 404 handling

userStories.title: Contact detail page
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to view a contact's screenshots so I can see uploaded images.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /users/[userId]/contacts/[contactId] dynamic route
Show contact header: name, created date, total screenshots
Display screenshots in a grid (thumbnails)
Each thumbnail shows: upload date, file size if available
Thumbnails are clickable to open lightbox
Breadcrumb navigation: Users > [User Name] > [Contact Name]
Handle contact not found: show 404 message
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Created contact detail page with screenshot grid, breadcrumb nav, 404 handling

userStories.title: Image lightbox viewer
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to view screenshots in a lightbox so I can see them full-size.
acceptanceCriteria: Create reusable Lightbox component
Click thumbnail opens modal overlay with full-size image
Show image metadata: filename, upload date, dimensions if available
Close button (X) in corner
Click outside image or press Escape to close
Arrow keys or buttons to navigate between images
Loading spinner while image loads
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Lightbox built into ScreenshotGrid component with full keyboard navigation, metadata display

userStories.title: Signed URL generation
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to generate signed URLs for screenshots so I can share or debug image access.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Copy Signed URL' button in lightbox view
Add 'Copy Signed URL' option on each thumbnail (icon button)
Generate signed URL valid for 1 hour
Copy URL to clipboard on click
Show toast notification: 'Signed URL copied to clipboard'
Show URL expiration time in toast
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Copy Signed URL buttons on thumbnails and in lightbox, toast with expiration time
